===Special Attacks===
#'''Feelin' Lucky''' - ''He loves to show off his cannons.''
#*80% chance to Stun for 2.5 seconds.
#'''Standoff Break''' - ''Point your weapon at him and he'll tear you apart.''

===Synergy Bonuses===
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Allies''' - [[Ratchet]], [[Bumblebee]] - +1~8% Armor.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Allies''' - Optimus Prime (MV1), [[Arcee]], [[Windblade]] - 2~3~8% Armor.
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Old Friends''' - [[Optimus Prime (MV1)]] - 20~30~70% chance to deal an additional Bleed stack when inflicting Bleed.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]][[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Weapon Specialists''' - [[Mixmaster]], [[Rhinox]], [[Hound]] - +3~4~9% duration for Damaging Debuffs. +2~4~6% Attack Rating in Alliance Missions.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Brother in Arms''' - [[Optimus Prime]] - 2~3~8% Armor for Autobots. +4~6~8% Melee Damage for Autobots in Solo Missions.
*[[File:synergy-incoming.jpg]] '''Medic Support''' - Ratchet - 1.3~2.5~7% of Base Health Repaired at the start of the fight. +3~4~5% extra Repair in Raids.
*[[File:synergy-outgoing.jpg]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - +10% Special Damage for all lower tier teammates.
==Strategy==
===Commander===
Ironhide is a preferred choice for beginner Commanders, as his few skills are all about high damage. Heavy spamming is a simple technique, but more often than not the opponent will sidestep most of his missiles.

===Opponent===
Simply sidestep or block Ironhide's Heavy and Special Attacks, or else suffer KO amounts of damage. 

Ironhide's Special II is a hard bargain to dodge ''and'' avoid taking large amounts of damage, especially when he has Obliteration awakened. If Ironhide feels like showing off his cannons, keep at distance at all costs.

===Strong Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
*'''Everyone without Evades, Armor, Shields, or Resistances''' - These bots will be easily torn apart.
*[[Megatron (ROTF)|'''Megatron (ROTF)''']] - Nobody will ever hail Megatron again.

===Weak Match-ups===
==== Bots ====
*[[Mirage|'''Mirage''']] has several counter-measures that reduces the potential effectiveness of Ironhide's attacks.
*[[Rhinox|'''Rhinox''']]'s Shields also reduce the effectiveness of Ironhide's missiles.
*[[Optimus Primal|'''Optimus Primal''']]'s Critical Armor will leave the master of burns unable to tear anything apart.
*'''[[Blaster]]''' - Slowing down Ranged Attacks will hamper his ability to tear anything apart at snail speed.
*'''[[Scorponok]]'''<nowiki/>'s Dazed ability will cause Ironhide's Special Attacks to miss completely.
*An awaken<nowiki/>ed '''[[Waspinator]]''' will revive in every fight whenever he gets torn apart by Ironhide’s specials.
*'''[[Jetfire]] and [[Soundwave]] -''' Reflecting the master of burns’s ranged attacks will only burn and tear himself apart.
*'''[[Grimlock]]''' - Ironhide will find this matchup to be a joke to the King of the Dinobots as his powerful burns from his missiles will be purified.
*'''[[Megatronus]] -''' The master of the demolitions’s relic of preservation will hamper Ironhide’s ability to tear the fallen apart. Ironhide may be the master of burns but Megatronus is the master of the demolitions.

==== Mods ====
* '''[[E.M.I. Module]]'''

===Recommended Modules===
Tear any raiders apart with Ironhide and these Mods!
* The [[Laser Guidance Module|'''Laser Guidance Module''']] makes Ironhide's ranged more deadly.
* With the [[Superconductor 2000|'''Superconductor 2000''']], it will be harder for a raider to defeat Ironhide without being Obliterated.
* '''[[Nightbird's Mark]]''' - Increases Ironhide's Crit Damage.
* The '''[[Robot Resource]]''' will give a higher chance for the master of burns to tear any raider apart!
